tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: Search the Funkey team building catalogue. Returns matching activities with the price per participant for the given party size, VAT included. Read-only.

query.description: What the group is looking for, in the visitor's words. E.g. "cooking workshop for a sales team", "outdoor competitive activity near Ghent".

participants.description: Number of participants. Prices in the results are for this party size.

locationLabel.description: City or place the group wants to stay near, e.g. "Gent" or "Antwerpen".

radiusKm.description: Search radius around locationLabel in km. Default 20.

maxBudgetPerParticipant.description: Maximum price per participant in EUR, VAT included.

limit.description: How many activities to return. Default 8.
